summary.text: Cathy Loy is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives who has represented District 163 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Democrat Brenna Barksdale is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Cathy Loy was born in Ottawa, Kansas, and earned a degree from Joe Herndon Area Vocational School in 1979.
As of 2024, she was affiliated with the Jasper County Central Committee, Republican Women, the Missouri Republican Assembly, Carthage Historical Preservation and Concerned Women for America.
Her Ballotpedia profile lists her profession as homemaker.

Loy was assigned to the House Budget, Elementary and Secondary Education, Children and Families, and Professional Registration and Licensing committees and the Joint Committee on Education for 2025-2026.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she listed three key messages: that she is pro-life, that personal liberty goes with personal responsibility, and that education reform should help every child succeed.
She also named tax policy, welfare, deregulation of business, foster care reform and healthcare cost transparency, including prior-authorization reform, among her policy interests.
